test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 18 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Who among the following was the Former Secretary (HRD), Information and Broadcasting (I&B) and has been appointed as the advisor to the Prime Minister of India in October 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Amit Khare**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Amit Khare is a retired IAS officer of the 1985 batch from the Bihar cadre.
 
• He has served as the Secretary of the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting (I&B) and the Ministry of Human Resource Development (HRD), now known as the Ministry of Education.
 
• He is credited with the drafting of the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020, a significant reform in the Indian education system.
 
• In October 2021, Amit Khare was appointed as an advisor to the Prime Minister of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ministry of Information and Broadcasting (I&B)**

 
 
• The Ministry of Information and Broadcasting is a branch of the Government of India responsible for formulating and administering the rules, regulations, and laws relating to information, broadcasting, the press, and films in India.
 
• The ministry is responsible for the administration of Prasar Bharati, the broadcasting corporation of India, and the regulation of content on television and radio.
 
• It plays a crucial role in disseminating information to the public and promoting cultural and artistic expression through various media platforms.
 
 
 
• **National Education Policy (NEP) 2020**
 
 
• NEP 2020 is a comprehensive framework to guide the development of education in the country, replacing the previous National Policy on Education, 1986.
 
• The policy aims to transform the Indian education system by 2040, with a focus on providing high-quality education, fostering critical thinking, and promoting innovation.
 
• Key highlights of NEP 2020 include the introduction of a new curricular structure (5+3+3+4), emphasis on early childhood care and education, and the integration of vocational education into mainstream education.
 
• The policy also emphasizes the use of technology in education, multilingualism, and the promotion of Indian culture and values.
 
 
 
• **Advisor to the Prime Minister**
 
 
• An advisor to the Prime Minister is a senior official appointed to provide expert advice and support on various matters of governance, policy formulation, and implementation.
 
• Advisors play a critical role in assisting the Prime Minister in making informed decisions and ensuring the effective execution of government initiatives.
 
• They bring specialized knowledge and experience to the administration, contributing to the overall efficiency and effectiveness of the government.
